# Create User Event

![Create User Event function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/dialog/events/05-create-user-event.svg)

[DialogUserInterface functions](../../dialoguserinterface/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Creates a new source UserEvent&lt;T&gt; from the complete type of the data specimen. The specimen value is not emitted. Distinct calls create distinct identities even with the same label and schema. Arrays, cluster field identities, Enums and embedded reference metadata remain part of T. Resources are local to this application execution instance; a saved document contains only the declaration.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Create a distinct application-local UserEvent&lt;T&gt; from a type specimen; its current value emits no occurrence. Preserve all type metadata. FROG default for an unwired specimen is f64; unnamed data receives a deterministic readable name.
